name: Squeeze-and-Excitation Module
definition: A module placed between the sampling layer and the inference layer in Mixer-NeRF to directly affect the prediction of density and color, helping with detail restoration and light color in complex scenes.
summary: The Squeeze-and-Excitation Module is a channel attention mechanism that dynamically recalibrates feature responses by modeling interdependencies between channels, distinguishing itself by focusing on channel-wise weighting rather than spatial decomposition.
